audit.why: TRICKY 7.5/10 matches a lane where Renekton owns levels 1-6 and Shen only reclaims it at two items; the mirror made no difficulty change.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four chart rows say Skill/Shen while their own why text says the opposite: whys[1] gives Renekton the level-2 double-up, whys[2] calls level 3 'his power peak', whys[3] and whys[5] both describe an even window.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is [Skill, Renekton, Renekton, Skill, Renekton, Skill, Shen] and agrees with the why text on every one of those rows.
audit.corrected: win[1]/phases[1].side and win[2]/phases[2].side to Renekton; win[3]/phases[3].side and win[5]/phases[5].side to Skill; ratings adjusted on the same rows. Proposed as one matched group. Row 0 left on Renekton against the packet's 'Skill' because whys[0] explicitly says he already wins neutral trades at 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page said the level-3 combo 'chains more burst than your Ki Barrier can absorb', and never mentioned that Ruthless Predator can cancel Stand United.
audit.why: Renekton's own ability text says the empowered W destroys damage shields on the target — Ki Barrier is not out-damaged, it is removed, and the same applies to a Stand United shield. Stand United is a channel, so his 0.75s/1.5s point-click stun at 300 range cancels it outright and burns 200/180/160 seconds.
audit.corrected: whys[2] restated as shield destruction with the 1.5s empowered stun; spikes[2] now warns never to channel R inside his stun range.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[3] told the player to track Ruthless Predator without ever giving its cooldown.
audit.why: Ruthless Predator is 16/14/12/10/8s — the punish window is long early and shrinks fast.
audit.corrected: whys[3] now names the 12 seconds at rank 3.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal appears only in the full layer (report[8], breakdown.late); the content layer never gives a timing.
audit.why: Cull the Meek heals on a 7s cooldown and is the whole basis of his short-trade rhythm, so the Grievous Wounds timing is the counter-play.
audit.corrected: mid now names buying Bramble Vest on the first back as what breaks the rhythm.

edits.before: Level 3 is his power peak: Slice and Dice into Ruthless Predator stun into Cull the Meek inside the stun window chains more burst than your Ki Barrier can absorb — only E-taunt first if you want to trade here.
edits.after: Level 3 is his power peak: an empowered Ruthless Predator destroys Ki Barrier outright and stuns for 1.5s, with Cull the Meek landing inside it — only trade here if your taunt goes in first.

edits.before: Fury bar and Ruthless Predator cooldown tracking decides every exchange — when both are in your favor commit your E-W-Q pattern; when they are not, farm and reset.
edits.after: Fury bar and Ruthless Predator tracking decides every exchange — it is down 12s at rank 3, so commit your E-W-Q inside that window and give nothing when it is up.

edits.before: Stand United comes online — concede the local lane and start scanning for 2v1 fights bot or a collapsing mid; that global swing is your primary carry tool.
edits.after: Stand United comes online — concede the lane and scan for a collapsing fight elsewhere, but never channel it inside his stun range or Ruthless Predator cancels it.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 settle into a discipline test: Renekton wants to maintain a short-trade rhythm where Cull the Meek keeps him healthy and you cannot recover between exchanges. Your job is to refuse those trades and only commit when his fury bar is near-empty and Ruthless Predator is clearly on cooldown — at that moment E-taunt into W-block into Q through the blade is your full damage window, and Ki Barrier absorbs his auto counter-trade. At level 6 Renekton's Dominus shifts the math: he gains bulk and fury-on-demand, turning any prolonged brawl into his favor. Your level 6 is Stand United — immediately scope the map for allies in danger. If he forces a Dominus all-in, E-taunt, walk into your W zone, absorb his autos, and wait for the slam to end rather than trying to match his damage for damage.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 settle into a discipline test: Renekton wants a short-trade rhythm where Cull the Meek keeps him healthy while you cannot recover — a Bramble Vest bought on your first back is what breaks that rhythm. Refuse those trades and only commit when his fury bar is near-empty and Ruthless Predator is clearly on cooldown — at that moment E-taunt into W-block into Q through the blade is your full damage window, and Ki Barrier absorbs his auto counter-trade. At level 6 Dominus shifts the math: he gains bulk and fury-on-demand, turning any prolonged brawl into his favor. Your level 6 is Stand United — scope the map for allies in danger. If he forces a Dominus all-in, E-taunt, walk into your W zone, absorb his autos, and wait for the slam to end rather than matching him damage for damage.
